verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents experiments that compare changes on the same inputs. You can rerun datasets through different application versions and compare evaluation results to tell whether an update is an improvement or a regression. It also supports comparing specific examples against prior runs, and dataset evaluators score experiments automatically like a unit test suite. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a side-by-side experiment comparison view (only playground prompt comparison is shown), and independent or hands-on corroboration of regression comparison workflows.
